title: Authority Crosswalk & Spatial Semantic Taxonomy
objective: Reconcile recovered structural and world-space concepts with MAI, completed ISE, World/Reality, Scene, Exploration, Research, Creature ecology, Asset and permission authorities; define spatial entity/relation families, ownership boundaries, stable references and the distinction between geometry, semantic structure and live state without creating duplicate domain ledgers.
preserved_boundaries: World/Reality, Scene, Exploration, Research, Creature ecology, Asset, Permission, MAI and completed ISE ownership remained canonical; SSA-01 projected stable crosswalk references without replacing those owners.
Geometry, semantic structure and live state remained explicitly distinct; pixel coordinates and visual adjacency did not become semantic, structural or gameplay truth.
Projected relations could reference only already-authorized stable semantic references; hidden/GM-only references, rejected relations and protected cardinality were excluded before projection.
Unconfirmed inference remained assistance-only and never became canonical; owner-specific validation and confirmation remained required where confidence was insufficient.
Consequential spatial meaning required an accessible nonvisual semantic summary; the visual canvas remained non-exclusive representation.
SSA-01 defined high-level entity/relation taxonomy only and did not implement SSA-02 construction primitives or authoring rules.
No canonical mutation, parallel spatial owner ledger, durable SSA-01 persistence or migration 0022 reservation was introduced.
No paid provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment was authorized.

Initial app run 33273927303 stopped before platform fanout because ACTIVE_FAMILY_CONTRACT still sealed ISE and rejected profile SSA-01; its own family_transition_rule required moving the active family to SSA and sealing ISE-08. Changed-evidence run 33273963834 then resolved only SSA-01 and exposed a source-verifier whitespace mismatch: raw artifact 9720927142 showed the required UI phrase was present across a JSX line break. Whitespace normalization in the verifier only produced final exact head f5e7d1cca6c1cdb6a06268bba4c4bb900e73c7ff, which passed selector, Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison.
diagnostic_hypotheses: The first two governed-start failures were one repository_state projection-drift family caused by shortening CURRENT_WORK_POINTER and ACTIVE_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY during the ISE-to-SSA transition; restoring exact sealed MV-CONT-008/007 maintenance identities reconciled the control plane before product mutation.

The first application failure was validation_contract/family-boundary configuration, not product behavior: the generic selector correctly enforced ACTIVE_FAMILY_CONTRACT, which still named ISE even though its family_transition_rule required switching to SSA after ISE-08 completion.

The second application failure was validation_contract-only: the authored UI contained the required pixel/visual-adjacency sentence but JSX source formatting split literal whitespace; raw artifact 9720927142 isolated the source-governance marker mismatch before the verifier-only repair.
No evidence indicated an owner-crosswalk, stable-reference, taxonomy, hidden-state, accessibility, determinism, persistence or SSA-02 boundary defect.
